zh-CN: 仓库活跃度补齐未来日期灰底，支持日期与仓储数量提示，并可点击按入库日期精确筛选。
空仓库引导扩展为六步，支持双区域框选与完成后的轻量 emoji 庆祝效果。
小项目过滤错误会统一显示并自动展开、定位、闪烁对应设置；同步优化工作台、回收站和使用说明文案。
en-US: Future activity cells keep a neutral background, show date and item-count tooltips, and filter the warehouse by exact inventory date.
Empty-warehouse onboarding now has six steps with dual-area highlighting and a lightweight emoji completion celebration.
Small-item filter errors now reveal and highlight the relevant setting, with clearer Workbench, Recycle Bin and quick-start copy.
